summary.text: Democrat Nicole Cannizzaro won the election for Nevada Attorney General on November 3, 2026, defeating Adriana Guzmán Fralick, according to unofficial results, and is set to take office when the new term begins.
A former Clark County criminal prosecutor, she is the Nevada state Senate majority leader and has held elected office for about a decade.

paragraphs.text: Cannizzaro was born in Las Vegas and holds a business degree from the University of Nevada, Reno and a law degree from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, William S. Boyd School of Law.
She worked as a criminal prosecutor in Clark County, joining the Clark County District Attorney's office in 2011, according to Ballotpedia.
A Democrat, Cannizzaro has represented District 6 in the Nevada Senate since 2016 and has been Senate Majority Leader since March 2019.
She won the November 3, 2026 general election for Attorney General of Nevada with 56.4% of the vote to Adriana Guzmán Fralick's 41.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
